name: Peanut Noodles with Charred Chicken Thigh & Cucumber Salad
description: Charred soy-marinated chicken thighs over rich sesame-peanut noodles with a cold cucumber salad.
instructions: Marinate the chicken for 15 minutes with 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 crushed garlic clove and a little black pepper.
Heat a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes on each side, until charred and cooked through to 75°C. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.

Mix 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tsp sesame paste, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp honey or sugar, 1 finely grated garlic clove, ½ tsp ginger paste and chilli flakes to taste. Gradually stir in 3–5 tbsp hot water until smooth and pourable.

Boil the noodles according to the packet instructions, reserving a mug of noodle water before draining. Toss the noodles thoroughly through the peanut sauce over low heat, adding reserved noodle water a tablespoon at a time until glossy and generously coated. Turn off the heat and stir in ½ tsp sesame oil. Loosen with another splash of noodle water if the sauce thickens before serving.

Thinly slice the cucumber, toss with ¼ tsp salt and leave for 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Mix 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, ½ tsp sugar and ½ finely grated garlic clove. Toss with the cucumber just before serving and finish with the sliced spring onions and 2 tsp sesame seeds.
Plate the noodles with the sliced chicken and cucumber salad, then finish with freshly ground black pepper.
